pilot_order: Reuse four pinned valid fresh fixed B waves; run R04 40/25/18/14 each30. No repeated valid control; full candidate stage fresh1200 excluding pilot.
pilot_gate: Both arms independently valid 30/30 each case; each candidate/reference mean ratio <=1+1e-10 numerical tolerance; sum of four ratios <4-1e-10. Significance/CI reported separately, no equivalence inference.
review_gate: After numerical pilot pass, independent read-only subprocess verifies SHA, all selections, objective, native returned values and actual saved-result runtimes. It never resamples native probabilities. Both gates required.
full_gate: Complete same new fixed control 40x30, retaining its valid pilot waves. Then candidate full stage is 40x30 fresh executions, excluding pilot. All 2400 comparison records valid; overall mean absolute and normalized cost difference <0; improved cases > degraded cases; both absolute and normalized small/medium/large group mean differences <=0. Numeric ties 1e-8 costs, 1e-10 ratios.
failure_policy: Ordinary no-solution/native-failure/numeric/time-out observations retained, never cost-imputed or retried. Only entire resource-interrupted or infrastructure-incomplete waves may retry in new attempt directories; no valid complete wave or stage repeated. Every attempt retained. Queue exhaustion never sets success.
resource_policy: Fixed 30 dispatch or wait. Use worst future expansion envelope plus per-size observed peak*1.25, 5GiB floor, ongoing foreign-growth reserve and disk floor. Never lower parallel or infer capacity solely from current worker RSS.
clock_policy: Controller supplies monotonic start before Popen. Includes interpreter/worker imports, registration/SHA reads, barrier waiting, data loads, all model/native/scoring, all incumbent/result/sidecar saves, stdout fsync and run terminal fsync. Post-save external upper measurement retained in independent timing journal; campaign summaries/audit computations are offline postprocessing, never extra optimization.
fixed_parameters: Original17 Solver methods AST unchanged except one run call; all module functions AST and4 dependencies unchanged. Native gate.99/screen.975/M1m/index/quick rejection/positive-only reuse/RNG advancement retained. Original problem and all9 original CDF-MITM stage slots retained. Auxiliary finite-support feasible subset is stricter, not an evaluator replacement.
